Chapter 705: Chapter 10 The First Type of Second Realm Fusion Rules (Subscribe Please)_3

The most crucial aspect of ultimate beings is to break free from the shackles of the River of Time, which requires control over time and space.

Of course, the more Chaos Rules one integrates, the greater the benefits, and understanding the legendary Chaos Rules could greatly benefit the pursuit of becoming an ultimate being.

“This Chaos Crystal…” Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred slightly as he took out a grey crystal, in which numerous rules’ essences were fused and scattered.

“If it were ten times, a hundred times larger, it might help me more than the black planet.” The Chaos Crystal was too small, and the depth of the rules it contained was not profound.

Of course, if the Chaos Crystal were ten times, a hundred times larger, Lin Yuan wouldn’t have acquired it.

In the Nine Floors Dark Tower of Demon Jade Space, the Chaos Crystal was considered a Twelve-Star Rare Treasure, and if it were ten times, a hundred times larger, it would definitely be categorized as a Twelve-Star Supreme Treasure.

...

…

Battlefield A098.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit sat cross-legged beneath that Eternal Spatial Rift that spanned thousands of miles.

“Lately, the Insect Race has been quite restless, inviting several Tier 11 special beings to join, probably to intensify the war.”

Though Lin Yuan had never left the area under that Eternal Spatial Rift, his True Body was very concerned about the intelligence on this Large Alien Battlefield.

After all, so far, he was quite satisfied with the rate at which he accumulated World-Breaking Origin Force on this battlefield.

If there were no other compelling reasons, Lin Yuan naturally would not be willing to leave.

“I now have nearly five hundred strands of World-Breaking Origin Force, most of which I’ve amassed here.”

Lin Yuan felt good, nearly five hundred strands of World-Breaking Origin Force gave him a sense of wealth he had never felt before.

“I hope the increase in war intensity is not too great…” Lin Yuan pondered for a while. The historical battles with the highest intensity of war had nearly devastated the large battlefields, with Supreme Beings themselves entering the fray.

If it really came to that, Lin Yuan naturally would not have the time to peacefully accumulate World-Breaking Origin Force here.

“Just fifty years ago, how did the Supreme Beings handle that aurora from beyond the universe?” Lin Yuan suddenly thought.

The power of that aurora reached an incredible level, effortlessly shattering a Large Alien Battlefield. If it were not for the joint efforts of numerous ultimate beings, the impacts would have been even greater.

The greater the power of the aurora, the more precious it proves to be, and for the Supreme Beings to intercept it was certainly a significant gain.

“Did the Supreme Beings create the Eternal Spatial Rift and not repair it, perhaps for such a time?” Lin Yuan looked contemplative.

The Eternal Spatial Rift contained extreme destructive power, which the Main Universe couldn’t heal by its own regeneration capabilities.

But if the Supreme Beings were willing, they could actively eradicate the destructive power within the Eternal Spatial Rift.

Once the power of destruction was gone, with the powerful healing abilities of the Main Universe, the rift could easily be repaired.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

After resting for a while, Lin Yuan resumed his cultivation.

“Great Destruction Rule…” Wisps of destructive essence appeared in front of Lin Yuan, and in terms of pure killing power, the Great Destruction Rule surpassed even the Life and Death Samsara Rule.

Of the six Pillar-level Fusion Rules Lin Yuan currently controlled, the Life and Death Samsara Rule was the highest realm, having reached the Second Realm.

The Great Destruction Rule was next, only a hair away from the Second Realm. Lin Yuan estimated that, whether sooner in a few days or later in a few months, he could elevate this Fusion Rule to the Second Realm.

At that time, Lin Yuan would have two Fusion Rules at the Second Realm, which would significantly enhance his combat power.

“Great Destruction Rule…”

In the Great Destruction Rule Guiding Space of the black planet, Lin Yuan immersed himself in understanding the essence of the Great Destruction Rule.

Simultaneously, while contemplating the Great Destruction Rule, Lin Yuan was also studying other Fusion Rules, borrowing insights from each, stimulating mutual understanding.

…

Deep within the Cosmic Starry Sky.

In a twisted area of space-time.

More than a dozen majestic figures stood around, and in their center, a hundred-mile-long, dazzling aurora quietly floated.

“This aurora, a rare Twelve-Rank material, can be used as the main ingredient to forge an ultimate weapon, how shall we divide it now?”

A figure with a single horn on his forehead spoke, all present were Supreme Beings.

Fifty years ago, more than ten Supreme Beings joined forces to intercept that aurora from beyond the universe. After fifty years of suppression, they finally removed the alien essence from the aurora.

And now, it was time to divide this aurora.

Actually, each Supreme Being at the scene wanted to monopolize this aurora.

But doing so would inevitably provoke the other Supreme Beings to act.

Under such circumstances, the more than ten Supreme Beings who were wary of each other, eventually proposed the relatively peaceful idea of dividing the aurora.

There was no choice.

At the level of Supreme Beings, there was no need to fight to the death over an external object.

This aurora was indeed precious, classified as a supreme item among Twelve-Rank materials, but before it was crafted into an ultimate weapon, it hardly enhanced the combat power of the Supreme Beings’ level.

“Battlefield A076, is one of the main battlefields of our Human Civilization, and it was pierced by this aurora, causing severe casualties among our Evolvers, so…”

Among the dozen Evolvers, Human Civilization’s Ancient Power Evolver spoke authoritatively, “We humans require one-fifth of this aurora.”

“One-fifth?”

The other Supreme Beings looked displeased.

Among the more than ten Supreme Beings, one-tenth each wasn’t enough, yet you take one-fifth?

“Ancient Power, isn’t that too much?”

The first speaker, the single-horned Supreme Being, spoke.

“Too much?”

“How do you account for the heavy losses suffered by our young humans?”

“They are the elite of our Human Civilization, our future.”

The eyes of the Ancient Power Supreme Being narrowed, “Without one-fifth, I cannot persuade my people.”

No sooner had he finished speaking than another eight Supreme-level presences forcefully broke through the spatial barriers and aggressively entered the scene.
